items.name: Putailai (Singapore) Pte. Ltd.
items.summary: Singapore holding company. The Malaysian registry data lists it as the 100% shareholder of Zichen Malaysia.

items.name: PUTAILAI (SINGAPORE) PTE. LTD (record typed as a person)
items.summary: A second record for the Singapore holding company, wrongly typed as a person. It is listed as a former 100% shareholder of Zichen Malaysia. Kept as a duplicate of the company record.

items.name: Shanghai Putailai New Energy Technology Group Co., Ltd. (上海璞泰来新能源科技集团股份有限公司)
items.summary: Shanghai-listed battery materials group (artificial graphite anode, separators, PVDF). Sayari shows it as shareholder of Putailai (Singapore). Its own shareholders are Chinese individuals, funds and banks.

items.name: Shanghai Putailai New Energy Technology Co Ltd
items.summary: A securities-data record with the group's English name. No identifier links it to the registry record, so it is kept as a lead.

items.name: Han Zhongwei
items.summary: Director of Zichen Malaysia; Shanghai (Pudong) address.

items.name: 韩钟伟 (Han Zhongwei)
items.summary: Listed by Sayari among Putailai group shareholders (stock-exchange data). Same name as the Zichen Malaysia director.

items.name: Liu Fang
items.summary: Director of Zichen Malaysia; Shanghai (Pudong) address.

items.name: 刘芳 (Liu Fang)
items.summary: Listed by Sayari among Putailai group shareholders. A very common name, so the match to the Malaysian director is weak.

items.name: Minh Thinh Loi Production and Trading Co., Ltd. (Công Ty TNHH Sản Xuất Và Thương Mại Minh Thịnh Lợi)
items.summary: Da Nang company registered in 2007, with a Vietnamese legal representative. It is the largest Vietnam-to-US shipper under HS 3801.10, but the goods are machined graphite jigs, not anode powder. The forced-labor flags are 'product blueprint' sub-tier flags, not findings about this company.

items.name: LTD Material, LLC
items.summary: US buyer of the graphite jigs from Minh Thinh Loi.

items.name: China Highwin (Thailand) Co., Ltd.
items.summary: The only Chinese-named shipper in the Thailand scan. One HS 3801.10 row (Nov 2024) to a US logistics company. A sister record carries a US freight-forwarder (OTI) licence number, so we treat it as a forwarder, not a producer.

items.name: China Highwin (Thailand) Limited
items.summary: Thai-registered record of the same name with a US Ocean Transportation Intermediary (freight forwarder) number.

items.name: Brilliant Group Logistics Corp.
items.summary: US logistics company that received China Highwin's one graphite row.

items.name: NextStar Energy Inc
items.summary: Cell maker (Canada/US) receiving 'carbon anode materials' via Singapore in Sep 2026; no shipper named on the row.

items.name: L-H Battery Company, Inc.
items.summary: US battery company receiving 'carbon anode materials' via Singapore in Aug 2026; no shipper named on the rows.

items.name: PT. OEC Freight Indonesia
items.summary: Indonesian freight forwarder. The only named shipper on the Singapore 'carbon anode materials' rows we pulled, which suggests Indonesian cargo moving through Singapore.

items.name: OEC Freight (NY) Inc.
items.summary: US arm of the same forwarding group; consignee on the forwarder-to-forwarder anode rows.

items.name: GrafTech Mexico SA de CV
items.summary: US-group electrode maker in Monterrey; a top Mexico-to-US HS 3801.10 shipper. Its goods include furnace electrodes (HS 8545), i.e. industrial graphite, not battery anode.

items.name: EVE ENERGY MALAYSIA SDN BHDSUZHOU (record 2)
items.summary: A trade-data fragment of the same plant: same company number and the Kedah EVE Industrial Park address, with 'Suzhou' run into the name. A third fragment (7JpFf6qgrAqSEzysj0htYQ) is typed as a person.

items.name: EVE Asia Co., Limited (trade/shareholder record)
items.summary: The record Malaysian company data names as EVE Energy Malaysia's shareholder (no percentage). Same name and building (The Millennity, 98 How Ming Street, Kwun Tong) as the Hong Kong registry company. It also trades: 4,358 shipments sent, including 64 rows to the Malaysian plant.

items.name: EVE Asia Co., Limited (亿纬亚洲有限公司, Hong Kong registry)
items.summary: Hong Kong holding company, registered 4 Jan 2013. Registry data shows EVE Energy Co., Ltd. holding 100%. Directors include Liu Jincheng and Chan Tsun Ming, who also sit on the Malaysian plant's board. It holds 24% of BTR's Changzhou anode company.

items.name: EVE Energy Co., Ltd. (惠州亿纬锂能股份有限公司)
items.summary: Listed Chinese cell maker in Huizhou, Guangdong, registered 2001. The US Defense Department added it to the Section 1260H 'Chinese military companies' list on 8 June 2026. Sayari shows it owning 100% of EVE Asia (Hong Kong), the Malaysian plant's shareholder.

items.name: 常州市贝特瑞新材料科技有限公司 (BTR Changzhou new-materials company)
items.summary: A BTR-named company in Changzhou. EVE Asia (Hong Kong) holds 24% of it per Sayari's registry data, so EVE co-owns part of BTR's group. The English label is ours; we didn't pull its other owners.

items.name: Liu Jincheng (director record, Malaysia)
items.summary: Director of EVE Energy Malaysia. His address in the Malaysian record is No. 38 Huifeng 7th Road, Zhongkai Hi-Tech Zone, Huizhou, the parent's registered street address. A 'Liu, Jin Cheng' is a director of EVE Asia (Hong Kong), and 刘金成 appears as a shareholder of EVE Energy Co., Ltd.

items.name: Liu Jin Cheng (director record, Hong Kong)
items.summary: Director of EVE Asia Co., Limited in Hong Kong registry data. Likely the same person as the Malaysian director record (same name, both on EVE group boards); no shared identifier.

items.name: Chan Tsun Ming (director record, Malaysia)
items.summary: Director of EVE Energy Malaysia, with a Padang Serai, Kedah address. A 'Chan, Tsun Ming' is also a director of EVE Asia (Hong Kong). A shared director is a second link between the plant and its holding company.

items.name: Chan Tsun Ming (director record, Hong Kong)
items.summary: Director of EVE Asia Co., Limited in Hong Kong registry data. Same name as a director of EVE Energy Malaysia.

items.name: QINGDAO TAIDONGRUI NEW ENERGY (trade record)
items.summary: The plant's largest graphite supplier by rows: 19 rows described as 'negative electrode material LD07-204-02' (HS 3801.90), China to Malaysia, Apr 2025 to Feb 2026. Sayari tags the record USA, but the goods leave China.

items.name: BTR NEW MATERIAL GROUP SALES CO LT (record 2)
items.summary: Second trade record for BTR's sales arm. 3 rows to EVE Energy Malaysia: 'BTR carbon anode materials' via Hong Kong (Jul and Sep 2025) and 'graphite LD04-008-01' (Feb 2026).

items.name: PT INDONESIA BTR NEW ENERGY MATERIA (record 6)
items.summary: A further trade fragment of BTR's Indonesian plant, not seen in Case 1. One row of artificial graphite (HS 3801.10), Indonesia to EVE Energy Malaysia, 1 Feb 2026.

case_summaries.case-9: Trade record for BTR's Indonesian plant with a Kendal shipper address. Shipped 9 rows of artificial graphite to Ford's Marshall, Michigan, battery plant (May to Sep 2026) and 2 more to a second Marshall record (Jul 2026). Six of the 9 rows were loaded at Chinese ports (Ningbo, Yantian).

items.name: 河北坤天新能源股份有限公司 (Hebei Kuntian New Energy)
items.summary: Chinese graphite company. One row of artificial graphite (HS 3801.90) to EVE Energy Malaysia, 26 Nov 2025. The English name is our translation.

items.name: HUNAN YUNENG SHUNXING SALES (trade record)
items.summary: Largest HS 2842.90 supplier to EVE Energy Malaysia: 40 rows (plus 11 under a second record), latest 9 Mar 2026. HS 2842.90 is the code commonly used for cathode powders such as lithium iron phosphate; we didn't read the product text.

items.name: HUNAN CHANGYUAN LICO NEW ENERGY (trade record)
items.summary: 30 rows of HS 2842.90 salts to EVE Energy Malaysia, latest 9 Mar 2026.

items.name: EASPRING TECHNOLOGY (CHANGZHOU) (trade record)
items.summary: 2 rows of HS 2842.90 salts to EVE Energy Malaysia (plus 1 under a second record).

items.name: Briggs and Stratton Corp (record 2)
items.summary: Second Briggs & Stratton record, same Wauwatosa address. 2 rows of INR21700/50E cells from EVE Energy Malaysia, Jul and Sep 2026, departing Singapore and Yantian (China).

items.name: TTI Consumer Power Tools Inc.
items.summary: Power-tool company (Techtronic group). 2 rows of lithium-ion cells (HS 8507.60) from EVE Energy Malaysia, Oct 2025 and Jan 2026, from Penang.

items.name: Milwaukee Tool
items.summary: Power-tool maker. One row of INR21700/40P cells (HS 8507.60) from EVE Energy Malaysia, Feb 2026.

items.name: Stanley Black & Decker
items.summary: Tool maker. One row of ICR18650/20P cells (HS 8507.60) from EVE Energy Malaysia, Dec 2025.

items.name: Energizer Battery Co Inc
items.summary: Consumer-battery company. One row of CR123A primary lithium batteries (HS 8506.50, not rechargeable) from EVE Energy Malaysia, Dec 2025.

items.name: ProTechnologies Inc
items.summary: One row of CR123A primary lithium batteries (HS 8506.50) from EVE Energy Malaysia, Jan 2026.

items.name: ABM Tucker GA
items.summary: One row of INR21700/50E cells (HS 8507.60) from EVE Energy Malaysia, Dec 2025.

items.name: Oregon International Air Freight Co
items.summary: Freight forwarder named as consignee on one row of INR21700/50E cells, Nov 2025. Logistics, not an end buyer.

items.name: Gotion High-Tech Co., Ltd. (国轩高科; record carrying former name Jiangsu Dongyuan Electrical)
items.summary: The listed Chinese parent (Shenzhen code 002074), headquartered in Hefei. This record still carries the former name Jiangsu Dongyuan Electrical Group. It shows Hefei Gotion as a 99.8% subsidiary, and also, wrongly, as a 99.8% owner: a loop in the data. Its SOE flags are adjacency flags, not proof of state ownership.

items.name: 国轩高科股份有限公司 (Gotion High-Tech, second registry record)
items.summary: A second registry record for the same parent, with the same credit code. It has no subsidiaries attached, so ownership searches from it return nothing.

items.name: Hefei Gotion High-Tech Power Energy Co., Ltd. (合肥国轩高科动力能源有限公司)
items.summary: Gotion's main cell-making subsidiary, 99.8% owned by the listed parent. It is the registered owner of Gotion High-Tech (USA), and it ships cells and parts to the US companies.

items.name: 国轩高科（美国）有限公司 (Gotion High-Tech (USA) Co., MOFCOM record)
items.summary: A US subsidiary of Hefei Gotion, recorded in China's outbound-investment filings. Gotion High-Tech's 2023 annual report pairs this Chinese name with 'GOTION INC.' and calls it wholly owned, so it is Gotion, Inc. of Fremont.

items.name: Gotion, Inc. (California registry)
items.summary: Gotion's US headquarters company in Fremont, California, registered 12 Mar 2014. Directors include Steven Cai. California lists no shareholders, so the registry can't show who owns it.

items.name: Gotion, Inc. (SAM.gov record)
items.summary: Federal contractor record for Gotion, Inc. It carries the California corporate number, so it is the same company. Sayari returns no owners for it.

items.name: GOTION INC. (trade record, Fremont)
items.summary: The importer of record for most US Gotion trade: 48660 Kato Road, Fremont. It receives artificial graphite, cells, packs and machinery from Gotion group plants in China. Many rows are delivered to the Manteno plant. Flags are sub-tier or one-hop flags, context only.

items.name: GOTION,INC. (trade record 2)
items.summary: A small trade record for Gotion, Inc. (9 shipments). It received an energy-storage control cabinet from Hefei Gotion in Feb 2026.

items.name: Gotion Illinois New Energy Inc (Manteno plant)
items.summary: The Manteno, Illinois plant company, 333 South Spruce St. Registered in SAM on 29 Jan 2026. It imports test modules, racking and packing goods directly; most inputs arrive consigned to Gotion, Inc. The press says it builds energy-storage systems and EV packs.

items.name: Gotion Illinois New Energy (trade record, mis-typed as a person)
items.summary: A trade record for the Manteno plant at the same address. Sayari types it as a person, which is a data error. 47 shipments to Jul 2025, mainly battery parts and pack covers.

items.name: GOTION ILLINOIS (trade record 3)
items.summary: A name-only trade record for the Manteno plant. It received a high-voltage box from Hefei Gotion on 27 Dec 2025.

items.name: HEFEI GOTION HIGH-TECH POWER ENERGY (trade record)
items.summary: A trade-data record of Hefei Gotion at 599 Daihe Road, Hefei. It shipped the artificial graphite (HS 3801.10) via Busan to Gotion Inc. in Dec 2025, plus cells, dummy cells and parts in 2025–2026.

items.name: HEFEI GOTION HIGH-TECH POWER ENERGYCO.,LTD (trade record 2)
items.summary: Another trade record of Hefei Gotion at 599 Daihe Road. It shipped Li-ion cells (some transshipped at Kingston, Jamaica) and an energy-storage pack to Gotion Inc. in Jul–Aug 2026.

items.name: Tongcheng Guoxuan New Energy Co., Ltd. (trade record)
items.summary: A Gotion group cell plant in Tongcheng, Anqing ('Guoxuan' is Gotion's Chinese name). The largest battery shipper to the US arm in 2026: Li-ion cells in Jul and packs bound for Manteno in Aug.

items.name: TONGCHENG GUOXUAN NEW ENERGY CO. (trade record 2)
items.summary: A second trade record for the Tongcheng plant. It is listed as a supplier to the Manteno trade record.

items.name: Green Innovation International Co., Ltd.
items.summary: A Taiwan-registered trader that ships Chinese-made battery pack covers, storage-system accessories and cables to Gotion Inc. and the Manteno plant, Jul 2025 to Sep 2026.

items.name: Volkswagen (China) Investment Co., Ltd. (大众汽车（中国）投资有限公司)
items.summary: Volkswagen's Chinese holding company. Sayari's registry graph lists it as a shareholder of Gotion High-Tech; 24.28% at 30 Jun 2026 (Gotion interim report); 18.98% once the 5.30% sale agreed on 28 Sep 2026 completes.

items.name: Nanjing Gotion Holding Group Co., Ltd. (南京国轩控股集团有限公司)
items.summary: A shareholder of Gotion High-Tech with 10.59% in the registry record.

items.name: Steven Cai (director, Gotion, Inc.)
items.summary: Director of Gotion, Inc. in the California registry. A person of the same name is deputy general manager and non-independent director of Gotion High-Tech in China. Same name only, so it is a lead, but it is the clearest people-link between the US company and the parent.

items.name: Steven Cai (deputy GM and director, Gotion High-Tech)
items.summary: Deputy general manager and non-independent director of Gotion High-Tech, per the Chinese registry record.

items.name: 1st Choice Freight Service Inc.
items.summary: A US freight forwarder named as consignee on 186 Gotion-related shipments, including Li-ion cells from Hefei Guoxuan, transshipped at Kingston, Jamaica, in Aug 2026. A logistics party, not an end customer.

items.name: Moxion Power Co.
items.summary: A US mobile power-storage maker. Sayari shows it buying Li-ion batteries (HS 8507.60) from Hefei Gotion: 28 shipments, the latest on 21 Feb 2024. A direct buyer from China, not from the US plants.

items.name: 1Energy Systems Inc
items.summary: Appears in the buyer rollup for Gotion-named US imports (15 shipments, HS 8507.60 among them, to Oct 2025). The shipper isn't shown per row, so this is a lead.

items.name: Caban Systems Inc
items.summary: Appears in the buyer rollup for Gotion-named US imports (5 shipments to Oct 2025). The shipper isn't shown per row, so this is a lead.

items.name: Livguard Energy Technologies Private Limited
items.summary: An Indian battery firm that Sayari lists as a buyer from the Gotion Inc. trade record. Likely Chinese-made goods sold under Gotion Inc.'s name, not exports from Fremont.

items.name: VinES Energy Solutions JSC (Công ty Cổ phần Giải pháp Năng lượng Xanh VinEG)
items.summary: A Vietnamese battery maker that Sayari lists as a buyer from the Gotion Inc. trade record.

items.name: Richardson Electronics, Ltd. — not resolved in Sayari
items.summary: An Illinois company that announced a battery-storage partnership with Gotion Inc. on 13 May 2026, using product from the Manteno plant. Known from its own press release only.

items.name: Gotion Big Rapids project (Green Charter Township, Michigan) — not in Sayari
items.summary: A planned $2.36bn battery-materials plant that was never built. Michigan declared Gotion in default in Sep 2025 and demanded $23.7m back in Jan 2026. Gotion is suing the township. Sayari has no record or trade for it.

items.name: Syrah Resources Limited
items.summary: ASX-listed Melbourne parent. Its 2025 annual report lists Twigg (95%), Syrah Technologies (100%) and Syrah Global DMCC (100%). Sayari's registry data reach only its Australian holding companies.

items.name: Syrah US Holdings Pty Ltd
items.summary: Australian holding company owned by Syrah Resources, per Australian registry data in Sayari.

items.name: Syrah US Holdings Pty Utd (member record in the US LLC's filing)
items.summary: Listed as the member (owner) of Syrah Technologies LLC. The name is misspelled ('Utd', 'Propietary') and the record isn't joined to the Australian one.

items.name: Syrah Technologies LLC
items.summary: The Vidalia, Louisiana active anode material plant. Registered 2017; Louisiana SOS ID and SAM UEI. Takes natural graphite from Syrah's Balama mine in Mozambique. Sayari shows no anode sales to US buyers, which is expected: domestic sales don't appear in customs data.

items.name: Syrah Technologies (trade record)
items.summary: Trade-only record at 2001 D A Biglane Rd, Vidalia. Received one small HS 2504 lot from Neuman & Esser, Dec 2022.

items.name: Syrah Technologies LLC – Vidalia 10 ktpa Active Anode Material Facility (EPA record)
items.summary: US EPA facility record for the plant, same Vidalia street address.

items.name: Twigg Exploration and Mining, Lda (record 2)
items.summary: Second trade record for Twigg. Shipped flake graphite to BTR Indonesia in Aug 2025.

items.name: Twigg Exploration & Mining, Limitad (record 3)
items.summary: Third trade record, no country attached. Shipped natural flake to two Qingdao buyers in Apr 2022.

items.name: Twigg Exploration & Mining, Limitada (Mozambique gazette record)
items.summary: Registry record from Mozambique's Boletim da República. No shareholders or officers attached.

items.name: Qingdao Nanshu Graphite Co., Ltd.
items.summary: Qingdao graphite company. 25 rows of Balama natural graphite, Aug 2022. Sayari doesn't show what it makes with it.

items.name: Qingdao Luowei New Materials Co.
items.summary: Qingdao buyer of 25 rows of Balama natural graphite, Oct 2022. Possibly the same company as a Case 4 supplier to POSCO Future M (name match only).

items.name: Qingdao Heshengkai Carbon Material
items.summary: Qingdao carbon company. 15 rows of Balama natural graphite, Aug 2022.

items.name: ASK Resources Ltd
items.summary: Shanghai/Hong Kong trader. 15 rows of Balama natural graphite into China, Aug 2022.

items.name: AW-Lin Jiangsu Supply Chain
items.summary: Jiangsu logistics/supply-chain company. 5 rows of Balama natural graphite, Oct 2022.

items.name: Dinur (Yingkou) Refractory
items.summary: Refractory maker in Liaoning. 2 rows of Balama natural graphite, Nov 2022. Industrial, not battery, use.

items.name: Qingdao Huateng Graphite Technology Co., Ltd. (青岛华腾石墨科技有限公司)
items.summary: One row of Balama natural flake, Apr 2022. Possibly the same company as a Case 4 supplier to POSCO Future M (name match only).

items.name: Qingdao Himalaya Special Glass Co.
items.summary: One row of Balama natural flake, Apr 2022. A glass maker: industrial use.

items.name: Dominik Georg Luh Technografit GmbH
items.summary: German graphite processor; the mine's largest single buyer by row count (29).

items.name: Grafitbergbau Kaisersberg GmbH
items.summary: Austrian graphite company; 19 rows from the mine.

items.name: PJSC Kombinat Magnezit
items.summary: Russian refractory maker, sanctioned per Sayari. One row of Balama graphite, 16 Feb 2022. This is the source of Twigg's 'sanctioned_adjacent' flag.

items.name: OAO Luzhsky Abrasive Plant
items.summary: Russian abrasives maker. One row of crucible-grade graphite for refractories, 5 Feb 2022.

items.name: Qingdao Mien New Material Co., Ltd.
items.summary: Chinese supplier of one 20 t lot of 'spherical graphite' (HS 3801.90) to Vidalia, Oct 2023, loaded in Korea. The only Chinese graphite seen entering the plant.

items.name: Jiangsu Qianjin Furnace Industry Equipment Co., Ltd.
items.summary: Chinese equipment maker. Carbonisation furnaces and parts to Vidalia: 12 rows, Dec 2022 – Jan 2026.

items.name: Zhejiang Leap Pulverization Equipment Co., Ltd.
items.summary: Chinese mill maker. Baghouses, rotary valves and mill spares to Vidalia: 3 rows, Jan 2023 – Jul 2025.

items.name: Shuanglong Group Co., Ltd. (双龙集团)
items.summary: Shanghai mixer maker. One oversize equipment shipment to Vidalia, Jan 2023.

items.name: Mountop Group / China Metallurgical Equipment Nanjing (大峘集团)
items.summary: Flagged Chinese state-owned in Sayari. Valves and baghouse housings to Vidalia, Dec 2022 and May 2023. This is why the plant carries 'chinese_soe_adjacent'.

items.name: Neuman & Esser GmbH & Co KG
items.summary: German process-equipment maker. Shipped 4.8 t of natural graphite (HS 2504) from the Netherlands to Vidalia, Dec 2022, likely for equipment trials (our reading).

items.name: TOV Zavallia Graphite (Zavallivskyi Hrafit)
items.summary: Ukrainian graphite miner. The only buyer of a Vidalia export in Sayari: a 50 kg lot, Dec 2024.

items.name: BTR (Jiangsu) New Material Technolo (trade record)
items.summary: US import-data record at No. 519 Jiangdong Road, Jintan, Changzhou. One row of lithium nickel-cobalt-manganese oxide (cathode material) to BlueOval SK, 15 Mar 2025, and one to General Motors, 6 Aug 2026.

items.name: BTR New Material Group Sales Co., Lt (record 3)
items.summary: A further US import-data record for BTR's sales arm, at the same No. 8 Guangyuan 4th Road address. Sold graphite to BlueOval SK (Jan to Jun 2025) and LG Energy Solution Arizona (2026).

items.name: Ford Motor Co
items.summary: US carmaker. Named by BTR's largest shareholder as the counterparty to a US$120m prepayment to BTR's Tangier anode company. Sayari holds no trade under this record for HS 3801, and its shortest-path searches to BTR timed out.

items.name: BlueOval Battery Michigan Cell Plant (trade record)
items.summary: US import-data record for Ford's LFP battery plant at 13700 W Michigan Ave, Marshall, Michigan, also using 201 Watkins Rd, Battle Creek. 148 rows received; 15 suppliers, mostly Chinese materials firms. Includes 9 rows of BTR Indonesia artificial graphite, May to Sep 2026.

items.name: BlueOval Battery Park Michigan (trade record)
items.summary: A second import-data record for the Marshall plant, at the same Battle Creek address. Sayari types it as a person, which is a data error. Its only supplier is BTR's Indonesian plant (8 rows received).

items.name: BlueOval SK LLC
items.summary: Ford's battery joint venture with SK On, with cell plants in Glendale, Kentucky and Stanton, Tennessee. One of 18 BlueOval SK records in Sayari. Received graphite from BTR's sales arm in 2025. Sayari lists no shareholders for it.

items.name: Pactra Tianjin Logistics Co., Ltd.
items.summary: Chinese logistics firm named as shipper on 41 rows of artificial graphite (HS 3801.10) from China to BlueOval SK, Jan to Nov 2025. The rows don't name the graphite maker.

items.name: Fan Cheng International Transport Service Co., Ltd.
items.summary: Chinese freight forwarder named as shipper on 4 rows of artificial graphite to BlueOval SK, arriving 2 Feb 2025. The maker is not named.
